scope: Worker instructions, not production permissions or live production evidence

chapters.title: Factory setup
chapters.subtitle: Tell us about the factory
chapters.goal: Write down facts about the factory.
chapters.have: Know the factory name. Have your machine or worker counts if you checked them.
steps: On Home, click 01 Factory setup.
Read the question under One thing at a time. Click Add answer.
Type the answer. Under How sure are you?, say if you counted it or if it is a guess.
Click Save this fact. Do the next question the same way.
Do not know an answer? Click Skip for now. Come back when you know.
Look at What can we assess?. Click Review & Submit to see what needs checking.
chapters.done: Your saved facts show under Factory details. Missing facts stay missing.
chapters.stop: Do not guess. Do not upload payroll, ID cards, or worker personal records.

chapters.title: Buyer order
chapters.subtitle: Check what the customer asked for
chapters.goal: Copy the correct order into the system.
chapters.have: Have the customer order and the cloth-and-trims list. Upload them in Chapter 10 if needed.
steps: On Home, click 02 Buyer order.
Under Choose buyer files, pick the Purchase order (PO) and Tech pack / materials list.
Click Read order details. If there is more than one order, pick the right one.
Check PO number, Style number, every Color, Size, and Pieces against the customer paper.
Check the Cloth & trims list. Fix wrong or missing entries. Add a short Review note.
Tick I checked the order details. Click Save draft order. Then click Plan material.
chapters.done: The page says Order saved. This is a draft, not an accepted order.
chapters.stop: If the paper is unclear, or two sizes do not match, stop and ask the order checker.

chapters.title: Plan material
chapters.subtitle: See what cloth and trims are needed
chapters.goal: Compare the order with the stock sheet.
chapters.have: Have a saved order, a stock sheet, and a price sheet with checked numbers.
steps: On Home, click 03 Plan material.
Under Choose an order, pick the customer order you are checking.
Open Check stock and costs. Add the Stock check and Material rates sheets.
No sheets? Use Blank stock sheet and Blank rate sheet. Fill them with checked facts.
Click Check materials. Read Still needs checking and check any missing cloth or trims.
If the numbers match your papers, click Save draft plan.
chapters.done: The page says Draft plan saved. Nothing was bought or taken from the store.
chapters.stop: If a price or stock amount is unknown, do not enter zero or guess.

chapters.title: Fabric store
chapters.subtitle: Check each roll of cloth
chapters.goal: Record what is on each fabric roll.
chapters.have: Have the roll in front of you, a tape or roll meter, and its paper label.
steps: On Home, click 04 Fabric store. For a new roll, click New roll.
Enter Roll ID, Fabric code, Supplier lot number, Shade band, and Bin / rack.
Write the paper-label length, your measured length, and usable width. Record marks or damage.
Choose PASS, HOLD, or REJECTED for the check. Say how you checked it.
Click Save roll check. Find the roll under Rolls we've checked.
Under Find matching rolls, choose an order, write a reason, and click Save draft pick list.
chapters.done: The roll check is saved. The pick list is only a suggestion.
chapters.stop: Wrong shade, short roll, damage, or missing proof? Mark HOLD and ask for a recheck. PASS is not stock approval.

chapters.title: Cutting
chapters.subtitle: Make a cutting plan and check the lay
chapters.goal: Tell the system the cutting plan and what was actually spread.
chapters.have: Get the approved marker and cut sheet from the cutting head. Have signed fabric issue details.
steps: On Home, click 05 Cutting. Choose the correct Buyer order.
Copy the Cut number, Marker code, cloth code, shade, plies, marker length, and fabric width from the cut sheet.
Add the marker sizes and garment parts, using the supplied sheets or rows on screen.
Write a short note. Click Save lay draft. Open it under Your saved cut plans.
After the fabric is spread, enter the actual ply count, measured marker length, and signed fabric issue amounts.
Click Save spread report. Then click Refresh status to check bundle release.
chapters.done: The plan and spread report are saved. Signed release is a separate check.
chapters.stop: Never call a draft a completed cut. If plies, roll, or shade do not match, stop before cutting or issuing bundles.

chapters.title: Sewing
chapters.subtitle: Practice moving bundles through sewing
chapters.goal: Show which bundle parts belong to a sewing job.
chapters.have: This chapter screen is a practice run. Real factory work needs approved jobs and real scans.
steps: On Home, click 06 Sewing. Choose a Cutting lay and Bundle group.
Enter the Plant, Station, Worker, and Machine class for the practice run.
Pick a Sewing job. If instructed, use Add a sewing job for this practice run.
Tap each correct part label in Record the bundle parts.
Click Start work on scanned bundles. Use Pause or Resume as needed.
Click Mark job done. If a part is missing or wrong, use Problem / Report issue.
chapters.done: Look under Saved sewing work for the practice record.
chapters.stop: This screen does not prove real sewing, attendance, or pay. Never use made-up scans for actual factory work.

chapters.title: Quality
chapters.subtitle: Practice checking a finished piece
chapters.goal: Check a practice garment and record any problem.
chapters.have: Use only practice garment records on this screen.
steps: On Home, click 07 Quality. Choose a Sewing order, Plant, and Piece number.
Click Record piece arrival.
Under Set up finishing for this style, pick the right practice steps and click Save demo finishing steps.
Enter the checker and station. Look at the piece. If it is good, click Pass check.
If damaged, enter the problem and click Hold this piece. After repair, click Mark repair done and check it again.
For a passed piece, click Mark next finishing job done for each step. Add the buyer tag number when shown.
chapters.done: Read the result under Saved quality work.
chapters.stop: A practice PASS is not an approved factory quality release. Do not pass a piece with a defect.

chapters.title: Packing
chapters.subtitle: Practice packing good pieces
chapters.goal: Put practice pieces into a carton and make a demo packing list.
chapters.have: Use only practice pieces shown as ready.
steps: On Home, click 08 Packing. Enter the practice worker, station, and reader details.
Click Refresh list. Under Ready piece, select one piece.
Enter a Carton number. Click Make new carton.
Click Scan piece into carton. Repeat for the correct practice pieces.
Wrong piece? Click Remove piece before sealing. When correct, click Seal carton.
Enter a Dispatch list number. Click Make dispatch list, Scan sealed carton, and Mark demo dispatch done.
chapters.done: The carton and practice dispatch list show in the lists.
chapters.stop: Do not ship any real carton from this page. A demo dispatch is not a truck handoff.

chapters.title: Factory report
chapters.subtitle: See where work is stuck
chapters.goal: Look at counts and spot problems.
chapters.have: In the practice view, have a saved cutting plan. A real report needs manager access.
steps: On Home, click 09 Factory report.
Under Choose work, pick the cutting plan to check.
Click Show progress.
Read the step counts. Open Where do counts not match? and What needs attention?.
If unclear, click Ask Aggie to explain. Check the source before making a decision.
Click Save this report if you need the practice record.
chapters.done: You can read the counts and saved report. Missing data stays missing.
chapters.stop: A practice number is not a real factory output count. Ask a manager about any large difference.

chapters.title: Upload files
chapters.subtitle: Keep factory papers together
chapters.goal: Add and find buyer or factory documents.
chapters.have: Have only the papers you were told to upload.
steps: On Home, click 10 Upload files.
Under Step 1 - Add files, choose the files and click Upload files.
Under Step 2 - Find your files, click Refresh and find the file name.
Click the file to see more. Use Download or View source details to check it.
Do not see an old file? Click Load older files. Do not see all its text? Click Load more extracted text.
Use Step 3 - Check and save records only when asked by the person checking the documents.
chapters.done: The uploaded file name appears in the file list.
chapters.stop: Do not upload payroll, ID cards, or private worker records through the development account.
